mostWorthwhile.text: Holding the glass was the most worthwhile moment: the slipping and corrected grip gave the earlier skin, nerve and muscle constructions a clear purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the supporting and surface layers felt fairly predictable, with little explanation beyond the picture descriptions.

surprise.text: The explanation that dead outer skin cells are continually replaced by living layers beneath was interesting and changed how I pictured the barrier.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the offered combinations had understandable purposes, though several were the only available choice.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it offered another concrete payoff like the glass, though the predictable assembly steps made me less curious about more of the same.
